newsitem.title: VATICAN: Vatican press says Pope's new book is bestseller.
newsitem.headline: Vatican press says Pope's new book is bestseller.

text.p: The Vatican's publishing house said on Thursday that Pope John Paul's new autobiography was a bestseller in Italy and France less than two weeks after its release.

More than 130,000 copies of the 120-page book, "Gift and Mystery -- on the 50th Anniversary of my Priesthood" had been sold in Italy while 80,000 copies had been sold in France since its release on November 15, the publishing house said.
The book sells in Italy for 15,000 lire ($10).
It said a million copies had been ordered for the book's release in the United States on December 11.
In the book, the 76-year-old Pontiff recounts his life in Poland during World War Two, his love for theatre as a young man and explains his decision to become a priest at the age of 26.
It follows the Pope's 1995 book, "Crossing the Threshold of Hope", which was published commercially and became an international best-seller. Royalties were donated to charities.
